- When all gray, click a colored dot to restore white squares
- Move the indicator to the opposite end to complete the level

Let me first check if clicking white squares works the same way, then figure out the indicator movement.
Actually, looking more carefully at the structure:
- Top: sky blue 4x4 square (rows 11-14, cols 31-34)
- Middle: gray structure with yellow X pattern
- Bottom: blue+sky blue pair (rows 35-38)
The indicator (b+S) is at the bottom. In level 1, the indicator was at the right and needed to move left. Here, maybe it needs to move UP?
Let me try moving UP to see if the indicator moves.
